Custom helicopter charter services allow you to meet tight schedules by avoiding traffic congestion and crowded airport terminals. Rainbow Air’s Helicopter charter service is ideal for unique charter flights, aerial photography, power and pipeline patrol, executive transportation and much more. If a helicopter is the best machine for the job, why not rely on the best among helicopters? Setting the industry standard in safety, reliability and quality service, Rainbow Air, Inc. is a fully authorized Federal Aviation Administration Air Carrier.
